caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent drinking glass positioned centrally against an off-white or beige background. The glass has a slightly irregular, cylindrical shape with subtle curves and asymmetries, and appears to be made of pale greenish-blue glass. There are small air bubbles visible within the glass material, especially in its lower half. The glass exhibits minor shading and reflections, which highlight its three-dimensional form and the thickness of the glass at the base. The background is plain, with no additional objects or details. In the lower right corner, there is a hand-written signature that reads “Anna Nemtsoff.”
title: Tumbler
